name: proto
description: Proto on your laptop: set up your account, import your product's design system, build prototypes, and serve them at public URLs.

PROTO_APP_URL.title: Proto app URL
PROTO_APP_URL.description: Your Proto app's address, for example https://<your proto domain>. Optional: setup writes it to ~/.proto/config.json from the setup document, and the plugin reads it from there.

PROTO_PROVISION_SECRET.title: Provisioning secret
PROTO_PROVISION_SECRET.description: The provisioning secret. Optional: setup writes it to ~/.proto/config.json from the setup document, and the plugin reads it from there.
